facts.fact: The Citizen reports on 28 August 2026 that the PDPC will inspect compliance with the Personal Data Protection Act, Cap 44, from 31 August 2026.

The PDPC found in preliminary assessments limited understanding of obligations, inaccurate registration data and unlawful data transfers abroad, and listed rectification directives, warning letters and fines as remedies; no sanction is named.
PDPC Director General Dr Emmanuel Mkilia announced the move to on-site inspections in Dodoma on 28 August 2026, after preliminary desk assessments.
